title: lenseff: detection efficiency for planetary microlensing surveys
description:
lenseff computes detection efficiency for planetary microlensing surveys by injection-recovery. It generates single-lens light curves on a survey's real observing calendar, injects binary-lens perturbations across a grid in (log q, log s) while marginalising over trajectory angle and event population, scores each against a freely refitted point-source point-lens model, and aggregates the recoveries into an efficiency surface with Wilson score confidence intervals.

All magnification calculations are delegated to MulensModel. Runs are reproducible by construction: every random draw is addressed by a stable key path rather than drawn from a running sequence, so results do not depend on worker count or task order, and every output file embeds the resolved configuration, its SHA-256 hash, the seed, the git commit and all dependency versions.
